title: Free agency opens with 144 players
detail: The offseason window began with a lockout expected after Dec. 1. AP reported a possible pre-lockout spending rush and no scheduled bargaining sessions.

title: Brewers win the World Series; offseason begins
detail: Milwaukee beat Tampa Bay in Game 5. Yankees president Randy Levine said he is confident both sides want a deal before Dec. 1.

title: Dueling press sessions before World Series Game 1
detail: MLBPA's Bruce Meyer called the cap proposal a nuclear bomb and said no extension has been discussed. Manfred cited unprecedented owner unity and fan polling behind a cap.

title: MLB proposes a 154-game season
detail: Also a best-of-seven Division Series and a weekly off day, as part of a seven-year deal. All contingent on a salary cap; the union said it was reviewing.

title: League sends clubs a 34-page lockout memo
detail: Guidance on operating during a lockout, including a ban on contact with players. Reported by The Athletic on Oct. 7.

title: The 60-game TV clause comes to light
detail: If a stoppage costs 60 or more games, most national broadcast deals extend through 2029, delaying MLB's planned media reset.

title: Player survey shows broad opposition to a cap
detail: An anonymous ESPN poll of players found most firmly against a cap, with a minority open to discussion.

title: MLB proposes roster rule changes
detail: Weekly rosters, a 14-pitcher limit and offseason free-agent quiet periods, all tied to a cap. The union objected to the quiet periods.

title: Union counters on the draft
detail: Keep 20 rounds and high school eligibility, raise bonus pools, allow pick trading and move the draft back to June.

title: All-Star Game sparring
detail: Manfred said owners are more united than at any point in his tenure; Meyer accused the league of telling fans the product is broken.

title: Union proposes roster and health changes
detail: 28-man rosters for the first 15 days, fewer option moves, and player access to club performance data.

title: MLB proposes contract limits
detail: Max five years and $202M for players changing teams, six years and $265M to stay. Minimum salary to $900K-$1M, earlier free agency and no qualifying offer, all tied to a cap.

title: MLB proposes a draft overhaul
detail: Cut the draft to 12 rounds with a $200M hard bonus system, bar high schoolers, and add an international draft.

title: President Trump backs a salary cap
detail: He publicly supported MLB's push; Manfred later said he would pass on outside help.

title: Union calls the cap institutionalized collusion
detail: Meyer estimated players would have lost over half a billion dollars in 2026 under MLB's plan.

title: MLB's opening proposal: a hard cap
detail: A $245.3M cap and $171.2M floor for 2027, a 50/50 revenue split, escrow, and equal sharing of all local revenues.

title: Union's opening proposal
detail: Minimum salary to $1.5M, luxury tax threshold to $300M, free agency after five years for players 30+, end the qualifying offer.

title: Formal bargaining begins
detail: Talks open on a deal to cover the 2027-31 seasons.
